title: Winds Over the Lower Sweet
summary: Between Palace Hill and the Lower Sweet boilers of Senchal, Khenarthi temple-wardens and harbour sailors hunt a skooma-lord cartel hijacking sugar-hulks in the Topal straits.

hook.rumour: Three spice-dhows bound for Senchal's Palace Hill quays were lured into Crimson Cove by false lantern-signals, and their sugar casks reappeared in the Lower Sweet boiler-dens.
hook.notice: SENCHAL HARBOUR MASTER & KHENARTHI TEMPLE: Mariners and blades wanted to break the false-beacon ring operating between Senchal and Crimson Cove.

npcs.name: Warden of Senchal
npcs.greet: Three spice-dhows bound for Senchal's Palace Hill quays were lured into Crimson Cove by false lantern-signals, and their sugar casks reappeared in the Lower Sweet boiler-dens.
talk: The trouble across Senchal began when sealed dispatches started bypassing Senchal.
If you mean to help the Maritime Court of Senchal, start by checking the trail between Senchal and Senchal Palace.

npcs.name: Chronicler of Senchal
npcs.greet: Keep your voice low—everyone at Senchal Palace is watching who asks after the old seals.
talk: We traced the couriers from Senchal Palace toward Senchal Merchant Square before they vanished into the brush.
Bring any ciphered tallies back to Senchal so Admiral-Factor Zaydak can see the proof.

npcs.name: Outrider of Senchal Merchant Square
npcs.greet: You made good time from Senchal Palace. The saboteurs have fortified the approaches near The Sweet Breezes Inn.
talk: Their ringleader is holding the inner chamber at The Sweet Breezes Inn with a picked guard.
Once The Sweet Breezes Inn is cleared, return to Senchal to seal the regional compact.

npcs.name: Speaker of Senchal
npcs.greet: Admiral-Factor Zaydak awaits word on whether the crisis in Senchal has been contained.
talk: The elders of Senchal have prepared the concord table for your return.
All of Senchal owes you a debt for standing between Senchal and ruin.
